name: cdm/product/collateral/CollateralInterestCalculationParameters
description: Represents parameters for calculating the amount the floating interest calculation, e.g.  for a single currency or defaults for all currencies.

compoundingBusinessCenter.description: Specifies the applicable business centers for compounding.

compoundingType.description: Specifies the type of compounding to be applied (None, Business, Calendar).

dayCountFraction.description: Specifies the day count fraction to use for that currency.

fixedRate.description: Specifies the applicable fixed rate  if used.

floatingRate.description: Specifies the floating interest rate to be used.

inBaseCurrency.description: If True, specifies that the interest transfers should be converted to base currency equivalent, or if False specifies that the transfer should be in the currency of the collateral.

rounding.description: Specifies the rounding rules for settling in that currency.

roundingFrequency.description: Specifies when/how often is rounding applied?

withholdingTaxRate.description: Specifies the withholding tax rate if a withholding tax is applicable.
